strings.name: David Zaslav
strings.role: Former President and CEO of Warner Bros. Discovery
strings.summary: David Zaslav is an American media executive who worked in cable television at NBC before leading Discovery and Warner Bros. Discovery. His career spans the integration of specialist channels, film assets and streaming businesses; he left WBD when its acquisition closed in October 2026.
strings.coverageNote: Checked through November 17, 2026. SEC filings confirm his October 6 departure; the old website title is not evidence of a current role. Completed transactions and expected benefits are distinguished.
strings.influence.rationale: Led Discovery and Warner Bros. Discovery, participating in international television, film and streaming consolidation.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: B.S. from Binghamton University and a J.D. from Boston University School of Law in 1985.
strings.facts.f2.label: Scope of roles
strings.facts.f2.value: Former President and CEO of Discovery and Warner Bros. Discovery; departure does not mean he has announced retirement from all professional activity.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Media asset integration
strings.highlights.h1.text: Scripps was acquired and WarnerMedia combined with Discovery during his tenure; corporate transactions do not mean he personally founded every channel in the portfolio.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Labor relations controversy
strings.highlights.h2.text: Boston University reported in May 2023 that inviting him as commencement speaker during the writers' strike drew criticism from some alumni; this records reactions at that time.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Acquisition closes; departure
strings.timeline.t1.text: SEC filings confirm Skydance completed the acquisition; Zaslav's directorship, executive role and employment ended that day.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Acquisition agreement signed
strings.timeline.t2.text: WBD, Paramount Skydance and other parties signed a merger agreement; the transaction had not yet closed.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Commencement invitation sparks discussion
strings.timeline.t3.text: His alma mater announced the speech arrangements and reported alumni criticism; the announcement does not prove the speech had taken place.
strings.timeline.t4.title: CEO of the combined WBD
strings.timeline.t4.text: Discovery and WarnerMedia completed their combination; trading under the new WBD ticker began April 11.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Scripps acquisition completed
strings.timeline.t5.text: Discovery completed the acquisition and changed its name to Discovery, Inc., expanding its lifestyle programming assets.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Takes charge of Discovery
strings.timeline.t6.text: Regulatory filings date his service as President and CEO to January 2007, distinct from the 2006 date in some biographies.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Joins NBC
strings.timeline.t7.text: Moved from legal work into television, later contributing to the development of CNBC and MSNBC.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Earns law degree
strings.timeline.t8.text: Graduated from Boston University School of Law and subsequently practiced law in New York.
